KeysToEntries.FirstSteps: You were far more successful then most recently spawned humans, and you managed to walk within moments, not years. Well done you!
KeysToEntries.GettingStarted: With Doric's help, you learned the basics of survival and crafting.
KeysToEntries.RatCatcher: Under Vannaka's careful tuition, you learned to create a meal that will keep you sufficiently alive, whilst regretting all the choices that have led you to this moment.
KeysToEntries.RuneMysteries: Zanik taught you the basics of Woodcutting, Runecrafting and how spells can make your life significantly easier.
KeysToEntries.DragonSlayer: You battled your way across Bramblemead and Ghornfel, and took down the dread dragon general Velgar. The region will be much safer now, thanks to you.
KeysToEntries.WitheringHeights: The wretched revenant dragon, Imaru, is finally laid to rest. Although it will take a very long time, the land of Fellhollow now finally has a chance to heal.
KeysToEntries.BlackKnightsFortress: The Black Knight Titan lays slain, and the path to the Umbral Sands stands open.
KeysToEntries.IcthlarinsLittleHelper: Fuzan's tyranny has been ended by your hand, and the dread dragon can no longer torment the Moon Garou of the Umbral Sands. A ravaged region now has a chance to heal, thanks to you.
KeysToEntries.GrowingPains: You learned the basics of farming.
KeysToEntries.ShrimpCatcher: Fishing is no longer a daydream to you.
KeysToEntries.RestlessGhosts: You helped put to rest the ghosts of some of the less fortunate members of your expedition.
KeysToEntries.GoblinDiplomacy: Zanik and you worked together to prevent a prophecy before it could happen. There was something sinister about an unknown dark force, but I'm sure it's all fine.
KeysToEntries.HighlightingTheProblem: Following the badly recorded instructions of the old Ashenfall Wizard's Tower, you learned to craft a special staff.
KeysToEntries.GraniteMauled: Deliving into dragonkin ruins is always perilous, but at least it can be rewarding. Thanks to your dungeon delving, you have uncovered the recipe for the legendary Granite Maul.
KeysToEntries.Heartstrings: You followed the trail of grief in lyrical form, attuning a crystal seed to the memories and discovered the Crystal Bow in return.
KeysToEntries.DogDays: Challenging a garou king could have gone much worse, but you were able to obtain a piece of the garou homeworld for Vannaka to study. In return he revealed his deepest, darkest secret - he gets quite fluffy once a month. Maybe you should invest in a line of squeaky slayer-monster toys?
KeysToEntries.CooksAssistant: Goblin chefs are surprisingly good at cakes, who would have guessed? Not me, that's for sure.
KeysToEntries.AnimalMagnetism: Magnetic chickens. Undead twigs. You sometimes wonder who writes this stuff. Still, you got a cool backpack out of it, so totally worth it.
KeysToEntries.ARoomWithAGarou: You gave an old blind garou a new home, so he can reminisce about long lost love.
KeysToEntries.AMelodyRemembered: A musical puzzle box didn't confuse you for long, and you uncovered the magical ring of Ashenfall's unluckiest necromancer.
KeysToEntries.TheGreatBodyRobbery: For some reason you thought it was perfectly fine to dig up corpses and hand them over to a deranged zombified head in a jar. For science, of course. Things went a little wrong and the professor is now more feathery than before, but at least you got a zombie arm out of the deal.
KeysToEntries.EvenMoreRestlessGhosts: You helped Zanik lay to rest some of the poor unfortunate spirits of Fellhollow.
KeysToEntries.TheWildHunt: The nature spirits have been severed from Fellhollow's corruption. They can now return when the Withering has passed, but for now they will work alongside you, in mount form.
KeysToEntries.ThingsThatGoBoomInTheNight: You put a stop to some mischevious exploding spirits, the underworld will be very grateful.
KeysToEntries.SeekingSalvation: You helped Doric to uncover the recipe for a powerful amulet.
KeysToEntries.DoricsQuest: Doric needed your help collecting special items related to legends he used to tell his son.
KeysToEntries.LettersForTheDead: You helped deliver some letters that Postie Pete had misplaced thanks to the interference of his sibling, Parcel Pete.
KeysToEntries.WhatRemainsIsWritten: Abraxus might be a bit unpleasant to work with, but… no, no, that's the end of that statement. You helped gather a bunch of documents for a clearly evil necromancer. I'm sure that will all be fine.
KeysToEntries.MirrorMirror: Sometimes when you stare into the mirror, the mirror stares back. Quite literally in this case. You performed a ritual that released this tragic character.
KeysToEntries.Biohazard: It turns out that some of Dowdun Reach's unusual situation was the result of an ancient chthonian demon… who is now unhappily a chicken. Still, with Zanik's help, you should be one step closer to finding a cure for these poor - *checks notes* - evil, Zamorakian cultists.
KeysToEntries.Wanted: Vannaka wanted you to hunt down some evil beastmasters,  to see how they might control their demonic minions. The answer? Kindness. There's a lesson here, probably.
KeysToEntries.WhatsTheirsIsMine: Doric was attacked by an evil Zamorakian wizard and a treasured heirloom stolen. You chased the culprit through the portals of Downdun Reach, only to find they'd run afoul of demons. Still, you gave Doric his thing back, so it all ended well.
KeysToEntries.Contact: Avisk was not expecting you to have even the slightest bit of common sense. Fortunately, your brain is not made of cobwebs and you were able to work with Zanik to put a stop to his plans to take over the kalphite hive.
KeysToEntries.BrinkOfExtinction: It's good that you put a stop to Zi's plan to join the ranks of Fuzan's KotHaar minions. He may be smaller now, but he's much happier… and much less of a threat.
KeysToEntries.MappingTheSands1: You found the moon sprites for Anamcara.
KeysToEntries.MappingTheSands2: You found even more moon sprites for Anamcara.
KeysToEntries.RogueTrader: You earned the favour of one of the Moon Garou traders by finding him moonstones for his collection.
KeysToEntries.TheMirrorCrackd: You helped repair the sacred mirrors for the Alcarrid tribe.
KeysToEntries.RagAndBoneGarou: You collected various animal bits to earn the support of some of the Alcarrid tribe.
KeysToEntries.SongOfTheAncients: You uncovered a lost song for Laguna the bard, earning his support with the Manafem tribe.
KeysToEntries.ScalingDifficulties: You defeated a dangerous red dragon, earning the support of some of the Manafem tribe.
KeysToEntries.BeastInTheSand: You followed a mythical beast to find a lost Moon garou and rescued her, earning the support of some of the Manafem tribe.
KeysToEntries.TheDigSite: You uncovered some archaeological texts for Lehran, earning his support with the Uzzer tribe.
KeysToEntries.SagaOfTheAdventurer: You recovered a lost saga for the bard, Laguna, earning his support with the Uzzer tribe.
KeysToEntries.MarkDay: You helped convince elders of the Uzzer tribe not to surrender to Fuzan and become marked.
KeysToEntries.Regicide: The Godeater has been slain! For millennia, Kuldra has held the realm in her iron claws, but now Ashenfall can finally be at peace. Well... from her at least.
KeysToEntries.RovingElves: You teleported Morwen away, allowing Ceridwen and Elowyn to find some peace and sanctuary.
KeysToEntries.FTUEComplete: You learned the basics of how to survive Ashenfall. Now to put them into practice.
